    Our Kai Ming Head Start Richmond Center preschool is right across from Lincoln Park and just a short walk from the Legion of Honor Museum. We serve 30 children from 08:00 a.m. to 04:30 p.m. The two classrooms are housed in the warm wooden structure of the Pine United Methodist Church. With our lovely Japanese neighbor ABC Preschool, children’s laughter always fills the sunlit halls of this location.

    A Place Where Your Child
    Can Grow and Shine

    Every child is unique, and our teachers take the time to learn about your child’s interests, strengths, and what makes them smile. Through play, stories, and friendships, your child will grow in confidence each day, and you’ll be part of every step along the way.
